title: Millions Like Us
description: A British worker in a defense plant falls in love with a World War II airman.

title: The Whistle at Eaton Falls
description: A newly promoted plant supervisor finds himself in the position of having to announce a layoff of his fellow workers.

title: Killer's Kiss
description: A New York boxer (Jamie Smith) corners a dancer's (Irene Kane) bad boss (Frank Silvera) in a mannequin factory.

title: Day of the Fight
description: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

title: The Killing
description: The organizers of a brilliantly conceived racetrack heist find their perfect crime beginning to unravel.

title: Flying Padre
description: Flying Padre

title: Paths of Glory
description: A World War I French colonel (Kirk Douglas) defends three soldiers picked to be shot for a general's blunder.

title: Fear and Desire
description: Four soldiers must confront their fears and desires behind enemy lines.

title: The Battleship Potemkin
description: Sergei Eisenstein's classic film depicts the mutiny aboard a czarist battleship during the failed revolution of 1905.

title: Strike
description: Authorities try to suppress a strike by factory workers in 1912 czarist Russia, with violent results.

title: Film Geek
description: Emmy and DGA award-winning director Richard Shepard mines over 200 movies, as well as his personal archives, for clues to understand his own cinematic DNA and his relationship with his mysterious father.

title: Make Way for a Lady
description: A teenager (Anne Shirley) plays matchmaker for her widower father (Herbert Marshall).

title: Twice Blessed
description: Identical twins (Lee Wilde) with different IQs trade places to reunite their parents (Preston Foster, Gail Patrick).

title: Three Daring Daughters
description: Sisters resent their divorced magazine-editor mother's (Jeanette MacDonald) new husband, a concert pianist (Jose Iturbi) she met while on vacation.

title: The Courtship of Eddie's Father
description: A young boy uses a peculiar and humorous standard to determine the perfect wife for his widowed father.

title: Les Girls
description: An entertainer's memoirs of her years in a musical revue lead her to court and a reunion with her former co-workers.

title: South Pacific
description: Navy nurse Nellie (Mitzi Gaynor) falls for plantation-owner Emile (Rossano Brazzi), who accepts a top-secret World War II mission.

title: Charles Grodin: Rebel With a Cause
description: A portrait of actor Charles Grodin, highlighting his comedy career and his devotion to social justice and prison reform.

title: Midnight Run
description: A scruffy bounty hunter has five days to bring a fussy embezzler from New York to Los Angeles.

title: 11 Harrowhouse
description: A diamond merchant (Charles Grodin), his girlfriend (Candice Bergen) and an inside man (James Mason) plan to vacuum gems from a super vault.

title: Seems Like Old Times
description: A writer (Chevy Chase) mixed up in a bank robbery seeks help from his ex-wife (Goldie Hawn), who's now wed to the district attorney (Charles Grodin).

title: The Woman in Red
description: A married San Francisco public-relations agent (Gene Wilder) sees an ad-campaign model (Kelly LeBrock) and becomes obsessed with her.

title: You, John Jones!
description: A man contemplates how lucky he and his family are to live in peace.

title: Algiers
description: A Paris thief who is hiding in the Casbah meets a woman who reminds him of home.

title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
description: Anarchists kidnap a couple's (Leslie Banks, Edna Best) daughter to hide a plot to kill a diplomat in London.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E10 — Batman's Last Chance
The Wizard thinks Batman and Robin are dead after he sends their vehicle over a cliff.

title: Dr. Kildare Goes Home
description: Young Kildare (Lew Ayres) woos nurse Lamont (Laraine Day), assists Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) and solves a medical crisis in his hometown.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
A Fractured Leghorn
Foghorn and a cat get into a debacle over a worm that Leghorn is chasing; Foghorn wants to eat the worm, but the cat wants the worm for bait to catch fish.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Lovelorn Leghorn
Foghorn Leghorn is pursued by a husband-hunting hen wielding a rolling pin.

title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
description: When an Oregon trapper decides to marry, his six rowdy brothers aim to follow suit, though not one has a sweetheart yet.

title: The Cincinnati Kid
description: An upstart card shark has a marathon game with the king of stud poker in the 1930s New Orleans.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: A Little Romance
description: A worldly Parisian (Laurence Olivier) tells two teenage lovers (Diane Lane, Thelonious Bernard) to kiss at dusk under the Bridge of Sighs in Venice.

title: Fat City
description: A young fighter (Jeff Bridges) inspires a boozing ex-boxer (Stacy Keach) working as a fruit picker to try a comeback.

title: Inside Moves
description: A man (John Savage) paralyzed by a suicide attempt meets an injured basketball player (David Morse) and other regulars at a bar.

title: The Yellow Canary
description: A singer searches for his kidnapped infant; screenplay by Rod Serling.

title: Operation Daybreak
description: British-trained Czech partisans (Timothy Bottoms, Martin Shaw, Joss Ackland) come home to assassinate the Nazi leader Reinhard Heydrich.

title: Zeppelin
description: A World War I British spy boards a German airship marked for a mission to steal the Magna Carta.

title: The Young Runaways
description: Three teens (Brooke Bundy, Kevin Coughlin, Patty McCormack) join other lost souls on the street in Chicago's hippie district.

title: The Bad Seed
description: Odd fatal accidents lead a woman (Nancy Kelly) to realize that her 8-year-old daughter (Patty McCormack) was born to kill.

title: The Yellow Canary
description: A singer searches for his kidnapped infant; screenplay by Rod Serling.

title: The Loneliness of the Long Distance Runner
description: An angry young man (Tom Courtenay) runs cross country on his own terms at the British reform school Borstal.

title: Our Miss Brooks
description: She (Eve Arden) teaches English, flusters the principal (Gale Gordon) and flirts with a colleague (Robert Rockwell).

title: All This and Heaven Too
description: In a 19th-century scandal, a French duke (Charles Boyer) and his children's governess (Bette Davis) become suspects in the death of his wife (Barbara O'Neil).

title: The Harvey Girls
description: A mail-order bride (Judy Garland) stops in a frontier gambler's (John Hodiak) town to work as a waitress.

title: American Graffiti
description: Four teens in 1962 California get a final, nostalgic glimpse of innocence before facing their post-graduation lives.

title: More American Graffiti
description: A couple (Ron Howard, Cindy Williams) and their high-school friends do their own things on four mid-1960s New Year's Eves.

title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
description: A young college student tries to impress his girlfriend while trying to meet the expectations of his father; he is asked to man his girlfriend's father's vessel but doesn't know his bow from his elbow.

title: Amarcord
description: Federico Fellini's episodic homage to life in a 1930s Italian seaside village as seen through the eyes of a boy.

title: Il bidone
description: Tired of impersonating priests, three small-time swindlers (Broderick Crawford, Richard Basehart, Franco Fabrizi) go their separate ways.
